_comment: Go Again is a printed keyword (printed_keywords carries GoAgain) and fires from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored here. MODIFY_NEXT_CARD_COST queue is turn-scoped (expires end of turn), not combat-chain-scoped per printed text 'this combat chain' - known approximation. Filter uses CARD_IS_TALENT for Draconic; release note confirms it applies to cards that gain Draconic from effects like Fealty.
